I’d love to see the intricate henna designs being traced on fingers and wrists, hear the rhythmic clapping and the soft hum of traditional songs, and taste the sweet treats that always seem to appear at these gatherings. The mehendi ceremony is more than just a pre‑wedding ritual; it’s a celebration of love, unity, and the shared joy of a new chapter. Watching everyone—especially the bride—glow with excitement while the henna slowly dries would be a beautiful reminder of how traditions weave us together. I’d probably spend a good chunk of the evening chatting with cousins, swapping stories, and maybe even trying my hand at a simple henna pattern (though I’m not sure I’d be any good at it!).
